QuestInfo.1: You've met the Black M-Forcer again in #b#m221040000##k. He asked you to defeat the high ranking #rChief Grays#k and to bring back #b5#k of their #bnotes#k. The Chief Grays are leaders of the Grays, so they might be harder to find... You should check out in #b#m221040300##k and #b#m221040400##k.
QuestInfo.2: You brought 5 #bNotes#k from the Chief Grays to the Black M-Forcer near Omega Sector. The Notes supposedly contain the history of the Grays... Maybe something useful can be found when the Notes are deciphered?

0.0: You're the one that helped me get rid of #b#o4230116##k the other day at the Kulan Field, right? The research on the force controlling them is just about to be concluded, and it's taken longer than expected, but I'm glad you're here now. I have something else to ask you for a favor. Will that be alright? Would you like to at least take a listen?

yes.0: Thank you for all your help. Did you know that there are ranks even amongst the Grays? We've found out about high-ranking Grays that have jurisdiction over the other Grays in this area. Each is called a #b#o4240000##k. There's not that many of them amongst the Grays, so it was really difficult to track them down. Anyway, they should probably be in #b#m221040300##k and #b#m221040400##k.
yes.1: Can you defeat these #b#o4240000##k aliens and bring back #b5#k of their #b#t4031102##k things? I think each #t4031102# contains some very valuable information. Come back to me when you have them!

no.0: Really...? I understand. Everyone seems to get a tad hesitant when dealing with ugly aliens like them. If you ever change your mind, however, I'll be right here.

1.0: Ah, you got the #b#t4031102##k! It took me a while just to find those guys... I guess I need to work harder! Anyway, here's your reward for helping out! I know this isn't much, but please take it!

yes.0: Thank you so much. Now, let's try to decipher this note. Just as I thought, this is written in alien language, so it's near impossible to understand what's written here, but with a little time, I'm confident that we can decipher this book. I gotta get this going, so I'll see you around!

item.0: It seems like you're still missing a #b#t4031102##k or two. Go find the high-ranking #b#o4240000##k, get their #b#t4031102##k, and come back. #t4031102# probably contains some juicy secrets!
